root_cause: The modal fails to open because the initialization function has multiple bugs: generateTriggerMap uses an array instead of an object, init uses undefined variables (triggerAttr, targetModal), and getFocusableNodes passes an array to querySelectorAll causing a TypeError. Additionally, the Space key event propagates and closes the modal when pressing Space on a checkbox.
repair_strategy: Fix generateTriggerMap to return an object, fix init to properly create Modal instances for each modal and register triggers without showing, fix getFocusableNodes to join selectors into a string, fix setFocusToFirstNode to use if-else for clarity, and add a Space key handler in onKeydown to stop propagation.
expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Enter on the trigger opens the modal, focus moves to the first checkbox, pressing Space toggles the checkbox without closing the modal, and the modal stays open (aria-hidden remains false).
functional_risks: Changes to init may affect multiple modal handling if more modals are added.
The Space key stopPropagation may interfere with custom Space-based shortcuts that rely on event propagation within the modal.
If other components depend on Space key bubbling from inner elements, they will no longer receive the event.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Enter on the trigger opens the modal (aria-hidden becomes false).
Verify that focus moves to the weekly checkbox after opening.
Verify that pressing Space on the weekly checkbox toggles it and the modal stays open.
Verify that pressing Escape closes the modal and restores focus to the trigger.
Verify that Tab key trapping works within the modal.
